boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 49 is labeled 'Super Hard' and features three tall boss chambers — left and right at `17` each, with a center yellow key block — all sitting above a packed lower chamber of blue, green, yellow, red, orange, and cyan blocks. Drain the lower chamber first to give all three bosses room, then let the matched `17` chambers collapse roughly in sync. Every phase depends on the lower chamber being open enough.
landmarks: Block Out Level 49 is labeled 'Super Hard' and features three tall boss chambers — left and right at `17` each, with a center yellow key block — all sitting above a packed lower chamber of blue, green, yellow, red, orange, and cyan blocks.
Drain the lower chamber first to give all three bosses room, then let the matched `17` chambers collapse roughly in sync.
Every phase depends on the lower chamber being open enough.

quickTips: All three bosses depend on the same floor — if the lower chamber still feels packed, none of them is ready.
The yellow center block between the bosses is an early key piece. Use it to start opening the upper section.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Drain the lower colored blocks (blue, green, yellow, red, orange, cyan) toward the side exits.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Use the yellow center block between the bosses as an early move to start opening the upper section.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Keep the `17` bosses parked while the lower chamber is still crowded.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Once the floor is about half-empty, let the boss counters start dropping.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Work both `17` chambers roughly evenly so they collapse in sync.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the late colored strips from the revealed upper space.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last side counters and chamber cleanup.

failurePoints: Working one top boss in isolation while the other two are still sealed — all three share the same floor and must open together.
Not draining the lower chamber before touching the bosses, which leaves no room for any of the three chambers to collapse into.
